title: Waggle Route
effect: Resolve Organise. Then add another acting-party Support to a free spot in the destination district.

title: Common Cause
effect: Choose a district containing another party that shares Honeycomb’s vote on its pending policy. Add one Honeycomb Support and one of that party’s Support there. Requires two free spots.

title: Every Bee Counts
effect: Add acting-party Support to every district that contains exactly one acting-party Support and has a free spot.

title: Dig In
effect: Resolve a movement Organise. Then add acting-party Support to the vacated source spot if possible; skip if full. Cannot recover an absent party.

title: Stonewall
effect: Resolve Smear. Then remove a second Support belonging to that rival from the same district.

title: Institutional Memory
effect: Choose a region and For or Against its pending policy. Add one Support of each party voting that way to that region, wherever space permits. Add at least one Support.

title: Spin
effect: Resolve Smear. Then add acting-party Support to the spot vacated by the removed rival Support.

title: Whisper Network
effect: Choose a district containing acting-party Support. Move one rival Support from there to a neighboring district with a free spot.

title: Shell Firm
effect: Move the acting party’s Firm marker and entire Operation pile to another party without a Firm marker. End this Lobby action.

title: Canal Network
effect: Move any number of acting-party Support from one district to another with enough free spots, along a connected route. Each intermediate district must contain acting-party Support.

title: Public Works
effect: Resolve Rally. Then add acting-party Support to a free spot in a neighboring district.

title: Mass Transit
effect: Choose a chain of two to five neighboring districts with a free spot at one end. Move one Support of your choice from each other district one step toward that end.

title: Scatter the Flock
effect: Resolve Rally. Then move as many acting-party Support as possible from that district into different neighboring districts with free spots, one per district. At least one must move.

title: Joint Campaign
effect: Choose a region’s pending policy and For or Against. Move up to three Support voting that way into one district in that region, each from a neighboring district. Requires room; move at least one.

title: Empty Every Nest
effect: Move one acting-party Support from as many districts with two or more as possible. Each must go to a different district with a free spot and no acting-party Support.

title: Quiet Hours
effect: Resolve Rally. Then add acting-party Support to an otherwise empty district, including an empty Bellwether Centre.

title: Midnight Leak
effect: Resolve Smear. Then remove one additional Support of the same rival party from a district neighboring the Smear target district, if possible.

title: Midnight Session
effect: Choose a closed party. Place one of your returned Firm markers there. That party opens with an empty Operation pile.
